items.text: Malik Nabers is active for Sunday Night Football vs Cowboys after murky Q status with knee; decision was up to him post full practice week. Giants elevated PS WRs earlier as contingency.
items.why: Full practice week; self-decision on readiness after ACL recovery.
items.implication: Start with risk of limited snaps/decoy; reverse any backup WR beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Primary target share if unrestricted; monitor early snaps/routes.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE for ARI vs LAC (ankle). Risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere; team wouldn't activate if major concern. Expected earlier.
items.why: Expected to play per reports; full or near clearance despite ankle sprain.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside; monitor for limited touches early.
items.opportunity: RB2 depth chart role, potential significant carries/routes if healthy.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) officially active for CHI vs CAR. Expected earlier; high-variance flex possible if limited.
items.why: Calf limited practice but cleared for game.
items.implication: Startable WR3/flex; watch snap/route volume for limitations.
items.opportunity: Boundary role with Caleb Williams; reverse Burden/Loveland full boosts.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected and officially inactive vs DET. Impacts Etienne projection upward as unchallenged lead back.
items.why: Weekend reports and official inactives; knee issue limited practice.
items.implication: Bench Kamara; elevate Etienne to strong RB2/flex with bulk work including pass-downs.
items.opportunity: Etienne full snap share, targets, carries; Kendre Miller as RB2/goal-line.

items.text: Weekend summary: Love (ankle) and Odunze (calf) EXPECTED; Kamara (knee) NOT; Josh Williams ACTIVATED (Tucker doubtful); Nabers NO NEWS yet. Kamara out boosts Etienne.
items.implication: Core Sunday AM intel for lineup locks.

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers everywhere despite risk he could be decoy; risk/reward after active confirmation.
items.why: Active; preseason belief in talent outweighs limitation risk.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 with ceiling if full go.
items.opportunity: High target share potential in return.

items.text: Ravens ruled out rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.opportunity: Slight bump to Zay Flowers or other BAL WRs.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere; active confirmation reduces injury worry though Cardinals caveat.
items.why: Active status signals confidence; preseason role.

items.text: AJ Brown (high ankle sprain) no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks. Confirmed multiple times.
items.why: High ankle; conservative timeline without surgery.
items.implication: Long-term sit; stream NE WRs or look for handcuffs/replacements.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Main slate news largely locked; no major projection changes expected except potential Nabers (Q knee) for SNF. PS elevations for Giants WRs. Projections live.
items.implication: Trust current projs; adjust only Nabers late.
items.opportunity: Stable roles elsewhere; Etienne boosted by Kamara out.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT Week 1 after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at LAC. Mayer elevated role.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; start Mayer as TE1 this week with target upside.
items.opportunity: Mayer primary TE targets/snaps in Kubiak scheme.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason belief in Bears offense (and him) unchanged despite Week 1 target concerns with Kmet/Raymond.
items.why: Preseason hype; want Bears offense pieces long-term.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in CHI scheme if volume rebounds.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not; preseason talk with new OC Sean Mannion (from Packers) validating early usage.
items.why: Preseason emphasis and early confirmation of role.

items.text: Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) vs ATL; trade possibility remains amid contract issues.
items.why: Back injury and ramp-up; murky future.
items.implication: Defensive impact for Steelers secondary matchups.

items.text: Pace notes: NO @ DET up-tempo; MIA @ LV slow slog. Full Week 1 snaps/pace from Thorman available.
items.why: Projected game scripts from Thorman analysis.
items.implication: Favor NO-DET skill players for volume; fade MIA-LV pace.
